title: Misuse / Joint logo lockup

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Show where an exceptional asset becomes misleading so partners do not extend a lockup beyond its approved role.
strategic_value: Clear prohibited applications can preserve the distinction between a partnership announcement and an enduring joint brand.
demonstration: Crossed collateral, paid media, merchandise, email and social layouts use the joint lockup; two altered combinations below add multiplication or plus signs.
practical_value: Reject self-made lockups and avoid using the approved lockup as the identity for a joint offering.

content_islands.name: Scope statement
content_islands.spec: Keep the warning that the lockup is not a joint-offering identity in the left column.

content_islands.name: Misapplied formats
content_islands.spec: Arrange crossed collateral, merchandise, email, paid-media and social examples across the main field.

content_islands.name: Altered combinations
content_islands.spec: Show the partner/IBM combinations using x and + at lower right with the approved-artwork-only warning.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The page rejects using a joint lockup as an offering identity and prohibits creating an alternative lockup; only the approved version may be used.
